title: CrowdStrike fiscal Q1 2027 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At April 30, 2026 CrowdStrike reported USD 4.553 billion of cash, USD 745.8 million of long-term debt, 257.881 million diluted weighted-average shares and USD 590.9 million of quarterly operating cash flow before the four-for-one split.
summary: The unchanged fiscal Q1 Form 10-Q supports the current net-cash, diluted-share, cash-flow, stock-compensation and incident-risk inputs used in the scenario-complete review.
